map_info.name: Monte Carlo Room
map_info.description: A workshop laid out as four stations of one Monte Carlo step. probability_box (the sampler) front-center. fishbowl with trail (the random walker) on the left. scales (the estimator) on the right. info_screen on the back wall showing the running mean. Whiteboard with the formal μ̂ = (1/N) Σ f(Xᵢ) statement. Walk = sample + walk + weigh + report. Built 2026-05-22 as the fourth algorithm-trajectory chamber.

learning_objectives: See the Monte Carlo loop as a workshop: sample → walk → weigh → report
Read the running mean on the info_screen as the estimator output
Notice the scales tilting toward whichever hypothesis the dice are favouring
